description: This file provides utility functions to create, retrieve, and delete browser cookies from JavaScript, including handling optional parameters such as expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: setCookie(sName, sValue, options)
methods.description: Creates or updates a cookie with specified name, value, and optional attributes such as expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: getCookie(sName)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie with a given name from document.cookie.

methods.name: deleteCookie(sName, options)
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration date to the past, using the setCookie function.
